rows.attchmntText: CARYSIL LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Carysil Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call held on November 05, 2026. The company reported a record second quarter revenue of INR275.7 crores, representing a 14.6% year-on-year growth. Core sink business volumes grew, with quartz sinks up 10% and stainless steel sinks up 8%. Capacity expansion for quartz and steel sinks is targeted for the end of FY2027. International partners include IKEA, Lowe's, and Home Depot. Domestic revenue grew by 30% in the first half. The company appointed Bobby Deol as brand ambassador for FY2027 and FY2028. Management maintains FY2027 guidance of 15% revenue growth and an EBITDA margin of 18% to 20%. Q2 EBITDA margin was 19.4%. Profit after tax increased by 5.8% to reflect higher raw material costs and sea freight.

rows.attchmntText: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited filed the transcript for its Q2 and H1 FY2027 post-earnings conference call held on November 06, 2026. The company reported standalone revenue of INR 534 crores, a 78% year-on-year increase from INR 300.49 crores. Consolidated revenue reached INR 544.8 crores, up 83%. Standalone EBITDA grew 60% to INR 51.16 crores, while PAT surged 213% to INR 10.22 crores. Consolidated EBITDA rose 77% to INR 56 crores, and PAT increased to INR 11.74 crores. Management highlighted capacity expansions in EMS, AC, and compressors, with compressor capacity set to double to 60 lakh units by the end of the financial year. The company aims for a consistent CAGR of over 30% in the coming years.

rows.attchmntText: TCC Concept Limited has informed the Exchange about giving Corporate Guarantee for Pepperfry Limited.
rows.desc: Giving guarantees/indemnity/ becoming a surety for third party
rows.voiceSummary: TCC Concept Limited has extended a corporate guarantee towards an Overdraft facility availed by its material subsidiary, Pepperfry Limited. The guarantee is issued in favor of ICICI Bank Limited to secure credit facilities aggregating to 30 crore rupees sanctioned to Pepperfry Limited. This amount comprises an Overdraft facility of 30.00 crore rupees, which includes a Working Capital Demand Loan sub-limit and a Bank Guarantee facility of 17.50 crore rupees. The facilities are intended to meet Pepperfry Limited's working capital requirements and permitted financial and performance guarantee requirements. The promoter group does not have any interest in this transaction, and the guarantee has been provided on an arm's length basis. The corporate guarantee will be treated as a contingent liability for TCC Concept Limited.

rows.attchmntText: SVP GLOBAL TEXTILES LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
rows.voiceSummary: SVP Global Textiles Limited approved un-audited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company did not prepare consolidated financial results. This decision follows the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process initiated against wholly owned subsidiary Shrivallabh Pittie Enterprises Private Limited. The National Company Law Tribunal passed an order on September 03, 2026. The Resolution Professional has not provided requisite financial information. Downstream subsidiaries are also under the Resolution Professional's control. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report. The report highlights the inability to comment on financial impacts due to confidential insolvency proceedings. It also notes uncertainty regarding the recoverability of advances and receivables. The board meeting concluded at 4:00 P.M. on November 09, 2026.

rows.attchmntText: Thomas Cook  (India)  Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the Analyst and Investor Earnings Conference Call held on November 3, 2026.
rows.voiceSummary: Thomas Cook India Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 3, 2026. Consolidated total income was INR 20,030 million, a 5% decline year-on-year. The Financial Services segment reported a 21% revenue increase, with gross turnover at INR 39 billion and EBIT at INR 452 million. The Travel segment revenue declined 7% to INR 15,683 million, with EBIT margins at 2.9%. Domestic travel grew 8%, while long-haul outbound faced headwinds from geopolitical disruptions and visa issues. The company expanded its branch network to 310 locations. Digital adoption in financial services reached 22.4%. The transcript is available on the company website.

rows.attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Bata India Limited has informed about transcript of Post Earnings Call
rows.voiceSummary: Bata India Limited filed a transcript of its Post Earnings Call held on November 4, 2026, with the BSE, NSE, and CSE. The call covered the 2QFY27 earnings. Sanjay Rao, Managing Director and CEO, reported a turnover of 8.6 million for the quarter, showing 7.5% growth. Adjusted profit before tax grew by over 31% year-on-year. The company noted double-digit growth in franchisee and I&D channels. E-commerce grew healthily despite B2B order deferments. I&D grew in mid-teens. Ad spends increased by over 4% year-on-year. Stock turn is higher than 2.6. Freshness in stores is over 90%. Aged inventory is close to 5%. The company aims to focus on franchising, premiumization, and casualization. New global product lines are in the pipeline. The transcript is available on the company website.

rows.attchmntText: Communication To Shareholders - Intimation Of Tax Deduction At Source (TDS)
rows.voiceSummary: Premier Energies Limited approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The board meeting was held on November 4th, 2026. The record date for eligibility is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Dividends will be paid electronically to shareholders with updated bank mandates in their demat accounts. The company will deduct tax at source under the Income-tax Act, 2025, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026. Tax rates vary based on shareholder category and residential status. Resident individuals receiving up to Rs. 10,000 in total dividends for the financial year 2026-27 are exempt from tax deduction. Shareholders must update their Permanent Account Number and residential status with the registrar or depository participants. Documents for lower or no tax deduction must be submitted to the registrar by November 11, 2026. Failure to provide valid documentation may result in higher tax deduction rates.

rows.attchmntText: Vinati Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Vinati Organics Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY2027 earnings conference call with BSE and NSE. The call covered financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Net income increased by 21% year-on-year to INR707 crores on a standalone basis. However, EBITDA declined by 27% to INR142 crores, and profit after tax fell by 33% to INR87 crores. Management cited rising logistics and energy costs due to the Middle East conflict as key challenges. The company announced a capital expenditure plan of INR500 crores for new specialty chemicals, funded through internal accruals. An additional INR500 crores investment is under consideration, with clarity expected in six months. Management expects a 20% to 25% improvement in top line for FY2027 and an EBITDA margin of 24% to 25%.

rows.attchmntText: Auri Grow India Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process

The Committee approved the reimbursement of expenses for the public announcement of the insolvency initiation. rows.attchmntText: Neogen Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Update on Fire Incident - Order for Revocation of earlier Directions issued by GPCB and granting of CC&A Amendment by GPCB.
rows.voiceSummary: Neogen Chemicals Limited received a Revocation of Direction order from the Gujarat Pollution Control Board on November 7, 2026. This order revokes previous directives issued after the March 5, 2025 fire incident at the Dahej SEZ Multi-Purpose Plant 3 facility. The Board also granted a provisional consent order, designated CC&A amendment AWH-163560, valid until March 19, 2030. The earlier direction had imposed an Environment Damage Compensation cost of Rs. 34.60 lakhs and required a Bank Guarantee of Rs. 7.5 Lakhs. Production at the affected plant was suspended, but the company has installed a new replacement MPP-5 plant which is currently in trial production. The revocation is subject to compliance with the submitted undertaking dated September 1, 2026, and the conditions of the new consent order.

rows.attchmntText: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on November 02, 2026. rows.attchmntText: Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 - Press Release".
rows.sm_name: Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited
rows.voiceSummary: Jaro Institute of Technology Management and Research Limited filed a press release dated November 06, 2026, regarding its financial performance. The company reported Total Income of Rs. 9,018 lakh in Q2 FY27, a 12% year-on-year increase. Revenue from operations was Rs. 8,774 lakh, up 10%. EBITDA grew 7% to Rs. 2,844 lakh, and Profit After Tax rose 9% to Rs. 1,854 lakh. For H1 FY27, Total Income increased 15% to Rs. 16,281 lakh. Revenue from operations stood at Rs. 15,849 lakh. EBITDA advanced 12% to Rs. 4,549 lakh, while PAT grew 21% to Rs. 2,971 lakh. Gross bookings for Q2 FY27 were Rs. 22,710 lakh, up 13%. H1 FY27 gross bookings totaled Rs. 41,735 lakh. The company announced new academic partnerships with IIT Kharagpur, CHRIST University, IIM Indore, IIT Roorkee, XLRI Jamshedpur, IIM Mumbai, and IIT Bombay. It also launched the #GrowWithJaro initiative with IIT Madras Pravartak. B2B partnerships were secured with PNB Gilts Limited and IIFL. The company received the Leader in Higher Education and Upskilling Award 2026.

rows.attchmntText: Data Patterns (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
rows.voiceSummary: Data Patterns India Limited submitted its investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The company reported net revenue of Rs 1,332 Mn and net profit of Rs 220 Mn for the quarter ended September 2026. Gross margin stood at 69.0 percent and EBITDA margin at 23.6 percent. The order book as of September 30, 2026, was Rs 17,236 Mn. The Chairman and Managing Director stated that fresh orders worth Rs 929 crore were received in Q2FY27. The company acquired a 100 percent stake in ST Advanced Composites Pvt Ltd for Rs 10 crore. The firm expects revenue growth of 20 to 25 percent over the next two to three years.

rows.attchmntText: GSPL Transmission Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the post results earnings conference call (Q2 & H1 - FY 26-27) held on Wednesday, 04th November, 2026 at 05:00 P.M. IST
rows.voiceSummary: GSPL Transmission Limited filed a transcript of the post-results earnings conference call for Q2 and H1 FY26-27 held on 04th November, 2026. The company reported standalone revenue from operations of INR 290 crores for Q2 FY27, an 8% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR 169 crores with a margin of 58.4%. Profit after tax was INR 120 crores. The company remains debt-free with a net worth of approximately INR 7,150 crores as of September 30th. Management highlighted a planned expansion capex program of approximately INR 3,500 crores covering over 700 kilometers of new pipeline projects. Execution is underway with EPC contracts awarded for the Anjar-Palanpur Pipeline Project worth INR 1,800 crores in July 2026. Transportation volumes grew 12% year-on-year to 45 MMSCMD. The company intends to fund expansions primarily through internal accruals and cash balances, though it retains financing approvals for potential debt if required.

rows.attchmntText: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and half-year ended 30th September 2026 earnings call held on 5th November 2026. Half-year revenue stood at INR1,367.2 crores, up 58.7%, with half-year profit after tax at INR7.35 crores, up 43.1%. The firm aims to increase its corporate business share from 51% to 65% to improve cash flow efficiency. The company also received the Mangalsutra Manufacturer of the Year Award at the India International Jewellery Awards.

rows.attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
rows.voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited received an order from the Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, Jalgaon, dated November 6, 2026. The order accepts the company's reply and drops proceedings initiated by a show cause notice dated September 29, 2026, for the financial year 2022-23. The tax authority ruled that the alleged excess availment of input tax credit was correctly availed and utilized. Consequently, the demand of Rs. 7,10,16,525, comprising tax, interest, and penalty, is dropped in its entirety. The company reports no financial or operational impact. No tax, interest, or penalty is payable pursuant to this order.

rows.attchmntText: Meesho Limited has informed the Exchange under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Update on acquisition
rows.voiceSummary: Meesho Limited completed the acquisition of 92.74% of Kirana Club Pte. Ltd. and its subsidiary Retail Pulse Labs Private Limited on November 7, 2026. The aggregate cash consideration paid was 1,86,71,12,524.48 rupees. Kirana Club is incorporated in Singapore, and Retail Pulse Labs is incorporated in India. The acquisition makes Kirana Club a subsidiary and Retail Pulse Labs a step-down subsidiary of Meesho Limited. The deal does not constitute a related party transaction, although promoters Vidit Aatrey and Sanjeev Kumar serve as directors on the boards of the acquired entities. Kirana Club reported a turnover of 45,808 Singapore dollars and a net loss of 837,754 Singapore dollars for the period ending March 31, 2026. Retail Pulse Labs reported a turnover of 16.04 crore rupees and a net loss of 1.60 crore rupees for the same period.

rows.attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Unaudited Consolidated and Audited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026".
rows.voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals Limited filed its press release regarding unaudited consolidated and audited standalone financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 grew by 8% to ₹ 1,303 Cr, with EBITDA up 22% to ₹ 292 Cr. Consolidated revenue rose 8% to ₹ 4,177 Cr, while EBITDA stood at ₹ 381 Cr. Consolidated results were impacted by higher UK natural gas costs and the temporary suspension of Kenya operations. Net debt as on September 30, 2026, was ₹ 6,127 Cr. The company cited challenging global market conditions, including soda ash oversupply and elevated input costs, while noting positive demand outlooks in Living Essentials and cautiously positive agricultural prospects.

rows.desc: Arrangements for strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie up
rows.voiceSummary: Aastha Spintex Limited has completed the acquisition of one hundred percent equity share capital of Falcon Yarns Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The aggregate cash consideration paid was thirteen thousand one hundred fifty one lakhs rupees for three million nine hundred forty five thousand three hundred sixty equity shares. Falcon Yarns Private Limited is engaged in textile manufacturing and finishing, specifically hosiery combed cotton yarn and cotton products. It was incorporated on June thirtieth, twenty fifteen. The turnover for the financial year twenty twenty five to twenty six was twenty two thousand five hundred forty six point six five lakhs rupees. Additionally, the Board of Directors recommended the appointment of Mr. Shyamsunder Kiranbhai Panchal as an Independent Director on the Board of Falcon Yarns Private Limited during the meeting held on November seventh, twenty twenty six.

rows.attchmntText: Shalby Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Shalby Limited filed a notice regarding the transcript of its Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY2027 held on November 4, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR318 crores, up 9.8% year-on-year. Consolidated EBITDA was INR46.4 crores, with a margin of 14.6%. Consolidated PAT stood at INR7.9 crores. Standalone hospital revenue grew 9.1% to INR250 crores, with PAT rising to INR23.5 crores. Occupancy improved to 52%. The Gurgaon unit revenue grew 50% to INR30 crores. MedTech consolidated revenue was INR316 million, with EBITDA at INR3.6 million. Net debt is approximately INR458 crores. The transcript is available on the company website.

rows.attchmntText: Sejal Glass Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Press Release 'Sejal Glass Limited Proposes Rs. 40.80 Crore Acquisition of Architectural and Automotive Glass Business.'".
rows.voiceSummary: Sejal Glass Limited has proposed the acquisition of Magnumtuff India Private Limited's Architectural and Automotive Glass business undertaking for Rs. 40.80 crore. The Board of Directors approved the execution of a Business Transfer Agreement for this slump sale. The transaction includes associated factory land and building. The target business reported operating revenue of Rs. 36.20 crore during FY26. This acquisition expands Sejal Glass's manufacturing network to four facilities in India. The new facility is located in Karnataka. The transaction is expected to complete on or before 30th November 2026. This is subject to the completion of required transaction formalities.

rows.attchmntText: Tata Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
rows.voiceSummary: Tata Chemicals submitted an analysts and investors presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 7, 2026. Consolidated revenue for the second quarter was 4,177 crore rupees, compared to 3,877 crore rupees in the previous year. Consolidated EBITDA stood at 381 crore rupees, down from 537 crore rupees in the prior year period. Profit after tax was a loss of 50 crore rupees, versus a profit of 219 crore rupees previously. For the half year, consolidated revenue was 8,432 crore rupees, with EBITDA at 936 crore rupees and profit after tax at 10 crore rupees. Net debt was 6,127 crore rupees as of September 2026. The presentation highlighted challenges including soda ash oversupply, weak industrial demand, and higher input costs.

rows.attchmntText: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Baheti Recycling Industries Limited submitted the transcript of its H1 FY27 earnings conference call to BSE Limited and NSE Limited on November 7, 2026. The call, held on November 4, 2026, reported revenue growth of approximately 68% year-on-year to Rs. 528 crore. EBITDA nearly doubled to Rs. 42 crore, while profit after tax increased by approximately 106% to Rs. 19 crore. Management revised FY28 revenue guidance upwards to over Rs. 1,300 crore. The company received in-principle approval for migration to the Mainboard from both NSE and BSE. A new aluminium wire rod division is planned with a scale-up to 25,000 tonnes. A 1.56 MW captive solar plant was commissioned to reduce energy costs.

rows.attchmntText: Sai Parenterals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Sai Parenterals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 2nd November 2026. Consolidated revenue rose 9% sequentially to INR196 crores. EBITDA grew 67% to INR41 crores. Profit after tax increased 33% to INR10.5 crore. The company acquired a 60% stake in Saicriti Pharma for INR83.83 crores and a 60% stake in Sai Prathyak Laboratories for INR15 crores using IPO proceeds. The Saicriti injectable facility targets completion in July 2027. Unit III expansion at Bhongir is nearly complete, with capacity rising to 155 million units monthly from December 2026. The board approved acquiring the remaining 25% stake in SP Analytics Private Limited. Noumed Pharmaceuticals renewed OTC supply contracts with EBOS Group and Wesfarmers, valued at AUD202 million and AUD30 million respectively. The Adelaide manufacturing facility is expected to commission in January 2027.

rows.attchmntText: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
rows.voiceSummary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited redeemed all outstanding Non-Convertible Debentures aggregating up to 25 Crore rupees issued in 2025. Subsequently, the company issued new Non-Convertible Debentures at a reduced coupon rate of 12 percent per annum, down from the earlier rate of 20 percent per annum. This refinancing was facilitated by a strategic investor, a global investment fund. The move aims to reduce the overall cost of borrowing, improve debt servicing capabilities, and strengthen the liquidity position. The managing director, Vikram Bhawanishankar Sharma, with DIN 01249904, confirmed the disclosure under SEBI LODR Regulations. The company stated that this optimization supports long-term value creation and financial sustainability.

rows.attchmntText: Meghmani Organics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript

Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at nearly INR666 crores, up 16% year-on-year, with net profit growing 193% to INR33.9 crores. rows.attchmntText: Oriental Aromatics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Oriental Aromatics Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on 05th November 2026. The company reported highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs. 318.19 crores in Q2, up 17% year-on-year. H1 consolidated revenue stood at approximately Rs. 578 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.80%. Management announced a technical, strategic, and manufacturing arrangement with Unilever Industries Private Limited. Production increased across Ambernath, Baroda, Bareilly, and Mahad facilities. The Mahad facility continues its commercial ramp-up, currently impacting consolidated profitability due to lower utilization. The company cited challenges from raw material costs and competitive pricing but noted improved sales realization and operational efficiency.

rows.attchmntText: The Andhra Sugars Limited has informed the Exchange about Closure of operations
rows.voiceSummary: The Andhra Sugars Limited Board of Directors approved the closure of its Sugar Unit at Bhimadole and Sulphuric Acid Unit at Kovvur on 7th November 2026. Operations for both units will cease effective 01.10.2026. The Bhimadole Sugar Unit reported a loss of Rs. 731.08 Lakhs in 2025-26, representing 6.44% of the company's total profit. The Kovvur Sulphuric Acid Unit reported a profit of Rs. 402.00 Lakhs, contributing 3.54% to the total profit. The closure of the Bhimadole unit is due to the plant being over 60 years old and the expansion of similar facilities elsewhere. The Kovvur unit closure is attributed to the non-availability of cane over recent seasons. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations.

Operational EBITDA rose 39.44% to INR 10.242 crores, with margins improving to 8.03%. Profit after tax increased 45.75% to INR 6.94 crores. Same-store sales growth was 9.8% in H1 FY27. rows.attchmntText: Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: Sarda Energy and Minerals Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on 2nd November 2026. The company reported a half-year EBITDA of INR1,326 crores and PAT of INR799 crores. Management highlighted entry into manganese ore mining with preferred bidder status for the Avagudem block in Andhra Pradesh, with operations expected in 12 to 14 months. The 600-megawatt thermal power plant completed maintenance, and environmental clearance for expansion to 1,200 megawatts is awaited. The company remains net debt-free with liquidity exceeding INR2,600 crores as of 30th September 2026. Credit ratings were upgraded by CRISIL. Expansion projects, including small hydropower and solar, are progressing. Regulatory approvals for coal blocks continue.

rows.attchmntText: Heranba Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Rajib Mukhopadhyay as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.

The Board of Directors approved this appointment during its meeting held on November 07, 2026. Mr. Mukhopadhyay will assume charge effective January 01, 2027. He holds over 20 years of experience in finance leadership roles across manufacturing, textile, consulting, IT, and sports entertainment sectors. Prior to this role, he served as CFO at Sutlej Textiles and Indofil Industries Limited. He is a Chartered Accountant from ICAI and completed an Advanced Management Programme at Harvard Business School. rows.attchmntText: Suraj Estate Developers Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of earning's call held on November 02, 2026
rows.voiceSummary: Suraj Estate Developers Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 02, 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 sales of INR206 crores, a 35 percent year-on-year increase, with collections at INR104 crores. Half-year sales reached INR347 crores, up 48 percent, while collections stood at INR190 crores. Profit after tax for Q2 was INR23 crores, down from INR33 crores in the prior year. Total income for Q2 was INR171 crores. Gross debt as of September 30, 2026, was INR800 crores. The company expanded its Suraj One Business Bay project, raising the GDV potential to around INR2,000 crores. New projects Suraj Nova and Suraj Madonna received commencement certificates and are targeted for launch in Q3 FY27. Management reaffirmed the FY27 presales guidance of INR700 crores.

For Q2 FY27, revenue declined 4% to Rs. 332.6 crore. EBITDA was Rs. 24.3 crore with a margin of 7.3%. Profit after tax fell 24% to Rs. 13.3 crore. rows.attchmntText: Rbz Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: RBZ Jewellers Limited filed a notice regarding the earnings call transcript for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The transcript was published on 03rd November 2026. The company reported revenue growth of 55% year-on-year to INR 225 crores. EBITDA increased by 3.5% year-on-year to INR 29 crores. Profit after tax stood at INR 16 crores. Retail segment revenue grew by 72% year-on-year to INR 148 crores. Wholesale segment revenue grew by 31%. The company opened a new retail store in Surat towards the end of September. Finance costs rose from INR 2.55 crores to INR 5.54 crores due to inventory buildup. One-time promotion expenses increased by INR 5 to INR 6 crores. Depreciation expenses grew from INR 86 lakhs to INR 1.7 crores. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015.

rows.attchmntText: Tata Teleservices (Maharashtra) Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
rows.voiceSummary: Tata Teleservices Maharashtra Limited disclosed an order dated November 6, 2026, from the Department of Telecommunications. The Access Services Wing imposed a penalty of Rs. 25,000 for alleged violations of conditions 39.17(i) and 39.22(iv) of the Unified License Agreement. These conditions relate to subscriber verification norms and inspection of bulk user premises. The company is reviewing the order and evaluating next steps. The filing was made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The impact on financial activities is limited to the penalty amount. No explanation for delay in disclosure was provided.

rows.attchmntText: VRL Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
rows.voiceSummary: VRL Logistics Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Total income rose 20% year-on-year to INR967 crores, driven by an 11% volume increase to 1,079,000 tons and a 9% rise in freight realization to INR8,840 per ton. EBITDA grew 43% to INR226 crores with margins expanding to 23.3%. Profit after tax surged 106% to INR103 crores. The company added 51 branches, bringing the H1 total to 67. Net debt decreased to INR337 crores from INR440 crores. The board recommended a share buyback of up to INR280 crores at INR320 per share, covering 87.5 lakh shares. Shareholders approved this via postal ballot on 3rd October 2026. The tendering window closed on 2nd November 2026, with settlement scheduled for 9th November 2026.

TPG will subscribe to equity and compulsorily convertible preference shares in two tranches. The first tranche involves an investment of INR 525,00,00,003 for 100 equity shares and 32,53,45,231 preference shares. The second tranche involves an investment of INR 275,00,00,588 for 12,93,34,496 preference shares, subject to business milestones and regulatory approvals. Post-investment, Kirloskar Oil Engines will hold 62.607% of Arka Fincap. The agreement grants TPG one nominee director and certain minority protection rights. There is no impact on the management or control of Kirloskar Oil Engines.
